text:
Alex (CSM): FYI — Orion Corp just finished their kickoff. They want a temporary throughput increase + Brazil (sao-paulo) region enabled for the next 3 weeks while they run a pilot. Renewal in ~60 days, execs watching.

Ryan (AE): Confirmed — customer needs 3x current qps during demo window. Wants region proximity for latency. Can we do a short-term config change instead of full Dedicated?

Alex (CSM): Prefer short-term, yes. They asked for an allowlist for two CIDR blocks and a rate lift for token caps.

OnboardBot: New ticket created: CS-4823 — "Orion: brazil region + temp throughput". Assigned to team: infra-ops.

Jasmeen (Infra): Thanks — can you paste the CIDRs and expected peak qps? Also any data residency constraints?

Diego (Network): I can handle the peering/allowlist if we get CIDRs and the ASN. Will need 24-36h window to provision routing.

Alex (CSM): CIDRs: 200.55.120.0/22, 200.55.124.0/23. Peak: ~1,800 QPS (current baseline 600). They said no regulated data classification — just latency-sensitive. Pilot dates: May 10–30 (two weeks stress, then scale down).

Liam (Billing): Quick heads up — temporary rate increases that change billing should be approved by finance. We'll put a short-term surcharge flag on the account. Ryan, do we have PO or card on file?

Ryan (AE): Card on file. Customer approved surcharge for pilot.

Maya (Enablement): I'll prepare a focused enablement session and a short playbook for engineers around retry/backoff during the burst. Do we want a runbook entry for the region failover behavior?

Jasmeen (Infra): Yes please. Also need to know whether we should provision an isolated pool or just route to existing Sao-Paulo nodes. For a 3x burst, isolated pool preferred to avoid noisy neighbors.

Alex (CSM): Customer prefers isolated pool if cost allows. They're sensitive to SLA for the demo.

Diego (Network): For allowlist I'll open a request to peering with NetOps. ETA for peering setup + firewall rules: 36h.

Jasmeen (Infra): I'll prepare the infra change. Proposed plan: 1) temporary rate config: increase token window from 100k/min -> 350k/min for account 9876 for May10-May30; 2) create isolated pool: 2x g4dn nodes in sao-paulo; 3) apply CIDR allowlist and peering. Rolling deploy with health checks.

Jasmeen (Infra): Config snippet I'll apply (placeholder):
```
account: 9876
region: sao-paulo
pool: isolated-pilot-9876
nodes: 2
rate_limit:
  token_window_per_min: 350000
  burst_multiplier: 3
allowlist_cidrs:
  - 200.55.120.0/22
  - 200.55.124.0/23
duration: 2025-05-10T00:00:00Z/2025-05-30T23:59:59Z
```

Alex (CSM): That looks good. Please also add an automatic rollback at end of window unless we get an extension.

Jasmeen (Infra): Will do. Will schedule rollback job for 2025-05-31 02:00 UTC.

Liam (Billing): Marking ticket CS-4823 "billing-approval" true. I'll add a temporary surcharge code and notify finance.

Ryan (AE): I'll confirm with the customer that the isolated pool and surcharge are OK and share final acceptance.

Maya (Enablement): I'll run a 30-min enablement call on May 9 for their engineers — CI keys, best-effort caching guidance, and token budgeting.

Diego (Network): Small ask: do we need to exempt this customer's traffic from our global rate limiting proxy at the edge? If yes, need exception rule.

Jasmeen (Infra): Yes — exempt at edge proxy for the duration. Tagging edge-proxy for rule change.

OnboardBot: CS-4823 updated: infra-change scheduled 2025-05-09T22:00Z, rollback 2025-05-31T02:00Z.

Alex (CSM): Risk note — renewal in ~60 days. This pilot is high-impact. If the demo goes well, we should start a short renewal play now (exec brief + performance report). Ryan, can you put that on your calendar?

Ryan (AE): Yep. I'll prepare a one-pager showing latency improvements and cost delta.

Liam (Billing): One more: please capture a snapshot of per-token costs during the pilot — we'll need it for negotiation.

Maya (Enablement): Will capture common failure modes and a short FAQ for their devs. Also collecting feedback after the first 48h of pilot.

Alex (CSM): Action items: Jasmeen (provision + rollback), Diego (peering + edge rules), Liam (surcharge + cost snapshot), Maya (enablement + feedback capture), Ryan (customer PO + renewal play). I'll follow up daily in this thread.

Jasmeen (Infra): Starting infra plan now. Will post a deployment checklist once ready. :thumbsup:

Diego (Network): I'll create NetOps ticket NET-993 and link it here.

OnboardBot: NET-993 created: "Orion peering — sao-paulo".

Alex (CSM): Thanks all — please flag blockers asap.

Ryan (AE): Customer acknowledged. Happy path confirmed. :rocket:

Maya (Enablement): Noted — I'll drop meeting invite for May 9.

Liam (Billing): Noted. Will post billing confirmation once surcharge code is live.

Jasmeen (Infra): Checklist posted: 1) reserve nodes 2) apply allowlist 3) apply rate config 4) run smoke tests 5) enable rollback job. ETA: 30h.

Alex (CSM): Great. Closing the planning wave here. We'll surface results post-pilot and capture any feedback that impacts renewal.

Diego (Network): Heads-up: if we need additional capacity beyond 2 nodes mid-pilot, ping me and I'll coordinate emergency scale.

Alex (CSM): Will do.

(End of thread)
